verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API and an MCP server that let external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) read/search/modify Objects, but there is no evidence of a built-in in-app AI assistant that itself answers questions, summarizes, or drafts grounded in the user's notes with UI-level data-scope controls — the docs describe it as a toolkit for external agents, not a native assistant feature. Missing for 10 (or even partial credit): a first-party in-app assistant UI, summarization/drafting features, and explicit data-scope/consent controls within Anytype itself.
